title: 第29集 第11章 画道第29集 第10章 孟川的目标
lines: 沧元界，江州城，孟府。
“阿川他最近彻底沉浸在修行中，所有事都抛到一边。”柳七月坐在竹椅上看着书，抬头看了书房一眼，书房中孟川正在在绘画中。
柳七月很清楚，丈夫拥有诸多元神分身，如今所有分身都不愿分心，可见到了关键时刻。
“八劫境……”
柳七月心中复杂。
从心底来讲，她甚至希望丈夫长久停留在‘半步八劫境’，等接近寿命大限时，再去渡劫。
然而修行路本就是勇猛精进，失去了勇猛精进之心，心灵意志更无望承载时空演化了。
孟川也无法控制自身修行进度，元神世界演化时空，就代表他只剩下一百年时间。
“按照阿川所说，离渡劫只有百年时间，他截止如今已经过去八十年了，所剩时间越来越少。”柳七月知道，丈夫能够成为元神八劫境生命体，去渡劫，是整个时空长河修行界的盛事。也是整个沧元界命运蜕变的契机，一旦孟川成功，沧元界将一跃成为高等生命世界。
甚至沧元界大量生灵都将受益，便是她，即便到了寿命大限，也可超脱轮回成为沧元界神灵，与天同寿。
对家乡世界，对族群，都是蜕变的契机。
可是……
对孟川，却是生死大劫！
“从年少时起，你就是这样，勇猛精进，不顾自身性命，曾日日都去追杀妖王，一己之力杀百万妖王。也闯荡域外实力突破，最终赢得妖族入侵战争。成劫境后也从未停下脚步……”柳七月曾劝过丈夫，战争获胜了，可以停一停，缓一缓，看一看这世间风景。世间的美好，不仅仅只是修行。
丈夫嘴上应着，可依旧修炼成匪夷所思的八劫境生命体。
听儿子孟安说，都有七劫境大能去拜访过孟安夫妇俩了，可见如今丈夫在时空长河中的地位。
“成了！”书房中传来喜悦声音。
柳七月听了连放下手中书籍，走了过去，便看到孟川美滋滋看着眼前展开部分的画卷。
“成功了？”柳七月走过去，看着画卷问道。
长画卷仅仅展开部分，是画的最后一部分。
最后一部分，是一截黑色龙爪，龙爪上鳞片都让柳七月心颤，仅仅看到，仿佛看到宇宙都在破碎湮灭，她脸色都不由一白。
孟川立即合上画卷，握住妻子的手，元神之力立即抚平了妻子元神的震颤。
“画作气息完全收敛，不外泄分毫。凡俗看了都没事，但越是境界高者……观看画卷领悟越多，受到冲击越大。”孟川说道，“你若是要看，如今勉强可以看第一幅。”
柳七月微微点头。
孟川慨叹道：“画道，可容宇宙时空。这次我以十九幅画，彻底绘画出我这些年的积累和领悟。”
必须得感谢龙祖。
龙祖提议建立的书山，九十六份永恒传承以及众宇宙的海量典籍，大大开拓了孟川的眼界，他甚至觉得自己画道方面，已经超出了‘六笔符印’秘法的范畴，延伸到更强层次。
其实，六笔符印，只是永恒存在收弟子的门槛而已，远远没到‘画道’的极限。
六笔符印，是个门槛，代表的是修行方向。
孟川截止到今日，在这方向中才感觉超出‘六笔符印’的界限，摸索向更深远层次。
“完善所学，是不是渡劫把握更大了？”柳七月问道。
“我都不知道渡劫会遇到什么。”孟川看着妻子，明白妻子的担心，笑道，“不过我猜，应该是把握更大了。”
他并非撒谎。
这次创出的画十九幅，代表如今所学最高成就。
但他真正高兴的是画道方面的提升，画道，是他观看世界，修行的思想核心。
剑道修行者，万事万物在剑道修行者眼中都可化作剑法！
画道修行者，万事万物可都化作‘画作’，在孟川眼中，这就是最根本的智慧！不管遇到什么样的境地，他都有信心以画道去参悟，如果哪一天他能参破所有一切，那便是‘无惑’，是’全知’，那时候便是永恒了吧。
乾源山，暗红空间。
content_en:
Cangyuanjie, Jiangzhou City, Meng Mansion.
"Achuan has been completely immersed in practice recently, and he has put everything aside." Liu Qiyue sat on a bamboo chair and read a book, and glanced up at the study, where Meng Chuan was painting.
Liu Qiyue knew very well that her husband had many soul clones, and now all the clones were unwilling to be distracted, which showed that they had reached a critical moment.
"Eight Tribulations Realm..."
Liu Qiyue felt complicated.
From the bottom of her heart, she even hoped that her husband would stay in the 'half-step eight tribulation realm' for a long time, and then go through the tribulation when he was close to the end of his life span.
However, the path of spiritual practice is all about courage and diligence. Without the heart of courage and diligence, there is no hope that the mind and will can carry the evolution of time and space.
Meng Chuan also cannot control the progress of his cultivation. The evolution of time and space in the world of Yuanshen means that he only has one hundred years left.
"According to what Ah Chuan said, there are only a hundred years left before he can overcome the tribulation. He has already passed eighty years now, and the time left is getting less and less." Liu Qiyue knew that her husband could become a living being in the Eight Tribulations Realm of Yuanshen and go through the tribulation, which was a grand event in the entire time and space cultivation world. It is also an opportunity for the fate of the entire Cangyuan world to change. Once Meng Chuan succeeds, Cangyuan world will become a world of higher life.
Even a large number of living beings in the Cangyuan Realm will benefit. Even if she reaches the end of her lifespan, she can transcend reincarnation and become a god in the Cangyuan Realm and live as long as heaven.
It is an opportunity for transformation for the home world and the ethnic group.
But...
For Meng Chuan, it was a life and death disaster!
"Ever since you were young, you have been like this, brave and diligent, regardless of your own life. You have been chasing the demon king every day, killing millions of demon kings by yourself. You have also made breakthroughs in strength outside the territory, and finally won the demon invasion war. You have never stopped after becoming a calamity realm..." Liu Qiyue once advised her husband. After the war was won, you can stop, slow down, and take a look at the scenery of the world. The beauty of the world is not just about spiritual practice.
The husband complied, but he still cultivated into an unimaginable Eight Tribulations Realm life form.
I heard from my son Meng An that great masters from the Seven Tribulations Realm have visited Meng An and his wife, which shows that her husband's status in the long river of time and space is now.
"It's done!" A joyful voice came from the study.
After hearing this, Liu Qiyue put down the book in his hand and walked over, and saw Meng Chuan looking at the partially unfolded picture scroll in front of him.
"Successful?" Liu Qiyue walked over and looked at the scroll and asked.
The long scroll is only the unfolded part and is the last part of the painting.
The last part was a black dragon claw. The scales on the dragon claw made Liu Qiyue's heart tremble. Just seeing it, it seemed as if she saw the universe being shattered and annihilated, and her face turned pale.
Meng Chuan immediately closed the scroll and held his wife's hand. The power of his soul immediately calmed the tremors of his wife's soul.
"The atmosphere of the painting is completely restrained and does not leak out at all. It's okay for ordinary people to see it, but the higher the realm... the more you understand when you look at the painting, the greater the impact you will receive." Meng Chuan said, "If you want to see it, you can barely see the first one now."
Liu Qiyue nodded slightly.
Meng Chuan sighed: "Painting the Tao can accommodate the universe, time and space. This time, I used nineteen paintings to completely express my accumulation and understanding over the years."
I must thank Long Zu.
The Book Mountain proposed by Longzu, the ninety-six eternal inheritances and the massive classics of the universe have greatly broadened Meng Chuan's horizons. He even felt that his Taoist painting had gone beyond the scope of the secret method of the 'Six-stroke Seal' and extended to a stronger level.
In fact, the six-stroke talisman is just the threshold for Eternal Being to accept disciples, and is far from the limit of 'drawing the Tao'.
The six-stroke talisman is a threshold and represents the direction of practice.
As of today, Meng Chuan feels that he has exceeded the limits of the "six-stroke seal" in this direction and is exploring a deeper level.
"If you improve what you have learned, will you be more confident about overcoming the disaster?" Liu Qiyue asked.
"I don't even know what I will encounter in overcoming the tribulation." Meng Chuan looked at his wife, understood her worries, and smiled, "But I guess I am more confident."
He wasn't lying.
The nineteen paintings created this time represent the highest achievement of what I have learned so far.
But what he is really happy about is the improvement in painting, which is the core of his thinking about the world and his practice.
Swordsmanship practitioners, everything can be transformed into swordsmanship in the eyes of swordsmanship practitioners!
As a practitioner of painting, everything can be turned into a 'painting'. In Meng Chuan's eyes, this is the most fundamental wisdom! No matter what kind of situation he encounters, he has the confidence to understand through the Tao of Painting. If one day he can penetrate everything, it will be 'no confusion' and 'omniscient', and it will be eternity at that time.
…
Qianyuan Mountain, dark red space.
